_comment: Default per-model WiiM device capability overrides. Edit the copy in the app data directory (next to settings.json) to change behaviour without code changes -- restart the app to pick up edits. Models not listed here keep the fully runtime-probed generic behaviour (per docs/wiim_api_notes.md: 'Capability detection must still probe at runtime... Never hard-code capabilities by model name alone'). Only documented exceptions to the generic probe are listed by default -- see docs/corrections.md and docs/wiim_api_notes.md Capability Nuances table.
